title: REFS:
content:
REFS:

@Video 1 = Volodymyr face. Controls face, hair and skin only.

@Image 1 = Volodymyr wardrobe. Controls clothing and build only; the face comes from @Video 1, the masked oval on that sheet stays out of the output.

@Image 2 = Bruiser. Controls face, moustache, scars, build and clothing only.

ACTIVE REFERENCES: all three 100%. Studio backdrops and reference framings stay out of the output.

SCALE: Volodymyr 192 cm and lean, Bruiser 178 cm and 140 kg.

DURATION: 30 seconds, one take, beat timings below are exact.

GLOBAL:

- lighting: one run of gelled fluorescent tubes on the dock ceiling, half teal half magenta, the only source; the wet floor bounces it back as fill

- color_grade: 35mm film still, Kodak Vision3 500T, fine grain, halation on the tubes. ~60% cold teal (concrete, water, haze) + ~25% magenta (skin, leather) + ~15% violet (shadow sides)

- setting: subterranean loading dock at night, concrete pillars, rebar ceiling, oil slicks on a wet floor

- ambience: transformer hum, dripping water, boot scuffs on wet cement; ambience ducks under every line

- atmosphere: damp haze in every depth plane, breath vapour on both men, every impact throws spray that drifts sideways and settles

- characters:

<Volodymyr> per @Video 1 and @Image 1: black shirt open over a white ribbed tank top, brick red cargo trousers, black braided belt, black sneakers with white soles, thin silver chain at the neck, red strap watch on the RIGHT wrist, short brown hair swept back, split lower lip from beat 1 on. Keep identical throughout. voice: mid low, carrying, unhurried, chest resonant, flat toned, faintly hoarse; the flat line holds through every hit and drops quieter on the last three sentences

<Bruiser> per @Image 2: distressed brown leather biker jacket open over a black shirt, torn black jeans, bald, long pale scar over the crown and down the LEFT cheek, heavy ginger moustache. Keep identical throughout. voice: low gravel bass, slow menacing growl, pushing louder as he loses ground

- camera_character: handheld throughout, operator breath, hand tremor, small live reframes

- blocking: they start three feet apart between two pillars, squared at each other, Volodymyr's back toward the far ramp, the near pillar over Bruiser's own right shoulder, an oil slick between them; each holds the other across that slick, and on the closing line Volodymyr first drops his gaze to the body at his feet, then lifts it into the lens

- dialogue rule: both men keep talking through the fight, breath breaking the words on impacts, every line landing on camera

SHOT:

- shot_type: medium two shot, Bruiser x 20% to 55%, Volodymyr x 50% to 85%, both y 10% to 95%

- camera_angle: eye level, easing lower as the orbit tightens

- azimuth: three quarter 45° on Volodymyr, rotating only through the camera arc

- camera_motion: one continuous handheld orbit counterclockwise around the pair, 2.5 metres closing to 1.2, never leaving the two men

- lens: 47° standard normal, rectilinear, straight verticals on the pillars, no focal drift

ACTIONS. Dialogue language: American English throughout.

- beat 1, 0s to 3.5s: medium two shot. Bruiser drops his weight, then hooks his right into Volodymyr's jaw. The head snaps toward his own right shoulder, sweat spraying. SFX crack of knuckle on jaw. dialog: Bruiser (low gravel bass, menacing growl), chin down, then says: "Higgsfield dropped Cinema Studio 4. Full production control."

- beat 2, 3.5s to 7s: tightens to medium close up past Bruiser's shoulder. Volodymyr wipes blood off his lip with the back of his RIGHT hand, then plants both feet. reaction: eyes go blank mid blink, then refocus and hold. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, flat toned, faintly hoarse), blood on his teeth, level gaze, then says: "It's Seedance 2.5 with a panel bolted on top."

- beat 3, 7s to 10.5s: widens to medium shot, camera shoulders in with the charge. Bruiser roars and charges, then slams Volodymyr back into the frame left pillar. Dust sifts off the rebar. SFX thud of body into concrete. dialog: Bruiser (low gravel bass, growl pushing louder), forearm across the chest, then says: "Thirty new camera presets. A light console. Fifty palettes."

- beat 4, 10.5s to 14s: close up on the clinch, camera low. Bruiser knees the ribs twice, then Volodymyr grips the leather lapels and drives his forehead into the moustached nose. SFX two sharp exhales, crunch of bone. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, faintly hoarse, breath breaking the first word), then says: "The camera presets are the only real thing in there."

- beat 5, 14s to 17.5s: eases out to medium shot as Bruiser staggers three steps, spits blood onto the slick, then swings wide. SFX liquid splat on wet cement, air displacement of the miss. dialog: Bruiser (low gravel bass, menacing growl), blood over the moustache, then says: "Acting console. Six emotions. Video extend both ways."

- beat 6, 17.5s to 21.5s: the arc carries onto Volodymyr. He slips the swing past his own left shoulder, then stamps the lead boot, then lifts Bruiser on an uppercut. SFX boot on boot, wet smack of the punch. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, chest resonant, flat toned), then says: "All of that is one prompt in plain Seedance."

- beat 7, 21.5s to 25.5s: orbit speeds through the finish. Volodymyr lands an overhand right to the temple, the knees fold, and Bruiser goes down face first into the puddle, spray blooming. SFX heavy slap into standing water, then silence for one beat. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, quieter, breath ragged), standing over him, then says: "You are paying for buttons."

- beat 8, 25.5s to 30s: the orbit settles frontal 0° and pushes into a close up. Volodymyr first looks down at the motionless body, then lifts his head into the lens, blood dripping off his knuckles. reaction: breath ragged and audible, blood flush on cheeks and neck, sweat from the hairline, pores and fine lines held, one slow blink before the words. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, chest resonant, flat toned, faintly hoarse, quieter on each sentence), then says: "Don't trust marketing bullshit. Use your head. Think critically."

TECHNICAL:

- continuous_shot: no scene cuts, one continuous shot, single take, one handheld orbit from first frame to last, 30 seconds total

- no subtitles, no captions, no on screen text, no background music over the dialogue, no extra dialogue beyond the lines written

fr.content:
REFS :

@Video 1 = visage de Volodymyr. Contrôle uniquement le visage, les cheveux et la peau.

@Image 1 = garde-robe de Volodymyr. Contrôle uniquement les vêtements et la carrure ; le visage vient de @Video 1, l’ovale masqué sur cette feuille reste hors du rendu.

@Image 2 = Bruiser. Contrôle uniquement le visage, la moustache, les cicatrices, la carrure et les vêtements.

RÉFÉRENCES ACTIVES : les trois à 100 %. Les décors de studio et les cadrages de référence restent hors du rendu.

ÉCHELLE : Volodymyr mesure 192 cm et est mince, Bruiser mesure 178 cm et pèse 140 kg.

DURÉE : 30 secondes, un seul plan, les timings des beats ci-dessous sont exacts.

GLOBAL :

- lighting: une rangée de tubes fluorescents gélifiés au plafond du quai, moitié teal moitié magenta, unique source ; le sol mouillé la renvoie en fill

- color_grade: image fixe de film 35 mm, Kodak Vision3 500T, grain fin, halation sur les tubes. ~60 % teal froid (béton, eau, brume) + ~25 % magenta (peau, cuir) + ~15 % violet (côtés dans l’ombre)

- setting: quai de chargement souterrain de nuit, piliers en béton, plafond en ferraillage, nappes d’huile sur un sol mouillé

- ambience: bourdonnement de transformateur, eau qui goutte, frottements de bottes sur le ciment mouillé ; l’ambiance passe sous chaque réplique

- atmosphere: brume humide sur tous les plans de profondeur, vapeur de souffle sur les deux hommes, chaque impact projette des éclaboussures qui dérivent latéralement puis retombent

- characters:

<Volodymyr> d’après @Video 1 et @Image 1 : chemise noire ouverte sur un débardeur blanc côtelé, pantalon cargo rouge brique, ceinture noire tressée, baskets noires à semelles blanches, fine chaîne argentée au cou, montre à bracelet rouge au POIGNET DROIT, cheveux bruns courts coiffés en arrière, lèvre inférieure fendue à partir du beat 1. Identique tout du long. voice: mid low, portant, posé, résonnant dans la poitrine, ton plat, légèrement rauque ; la ligne plate se maintient à travers chaque coup et devient plus basse sur les trois dernières phrases

<Bruiser> d’après @Image 2 : veste de biker en cuir brun vieilli ouverte sur une chemise noire, jean noir déchiré, chauve, longue cicatrice pâle traversant le crâne et descendant sur la JOUE GAUCHE, grosse moustache rousse. Identique tout du long. voice: basse rocailleuse, grognement lent et menaçant, de plus en plus fort à mesure qu’il perd du terrain

- camera_character: handheld tout du long, souffle de l’opérateur, tremblement de la main, petits recadrages en direct

- blocking: ils commencent à trois pieds l’un de l’autre entre deux piliers, face à face, le dos de Volodymyr tourné vers la rampe du fond, le pilier proche derrière l’épaule droite de Bruiser, une nappe d’huile entre eux ; chacun garde l’autre à travers cette nappe, et sur la dernière réplique Volodymyr baisse d’abord les yeux vers le corps à ses pieds, puis les relève vers l’objectif

- dialogue rule: les deux hommes continuent de parler pendant le combat, le souffle cassant les mots au moment des impacts, chaque réplique doit tomber face caméra

SHOT :

- shot_type: plan moyen à deux, Bruiser x 20 % à 55 %, Volodymyr x 50 % à 85 %, les deux y 10 % à 95 %

- camera_angle: à hauteur des yeux, s’abaissant légèrement à mesure que l’orbite se resserre

- azimuth: trois-quarts 45° sur Volodymyr, rotation uniquement via l’arc de caméra

- camera_motion: une seule orbite handheld continue dans le sens antihoraire autour du duo, de 2,5 mètres à 1,2 mètre, sans jamais quitter les deux hommes

- lens: 47° standard normal, rectilinéaire, verticales droites sur les piliers, aucune dérive de focale

ACTIONS. Dialogue language: American English throughout.

- beat 1, 0s to 3.5s: plan moyen à deux. Bruiser baisse son poids, puis envoie un crochet du droit dans la mâchoire de Volodymyr. La tête part vers sa propre épaule droite, la sueur éclabousse. SFX craquement d’une phalange sur la mâchoire. dialog: Bruiser (basse rocailleuse, grognement menaçant), menton rentré, then says: "Higgsfield dropped Cinema Studio 4. Full production control."

- beat 2, 3.5s to 7s: resserre en plan moyen rapproché au-delà de l’épaule de Bruiser. Volodymyr essuie le sang de sa lèvre avec le dos de sa MAIN DROITE, puis plante les deux pieds. reaction: les yeux deviennent vides au milieu d’un clignement, puis se refocalisent et tiennent. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, ton plat, légèrement rauque), blood on his teeth, regard fixe, then says: "It's Seedance 2.5 with a panel bolted on top."

- beat 3, 7s to 10.5s: élargit en plan moyen, la caméra rentre dans le mouvement de charge. Bruiser rugit et charge, puis plaque Volodymyr contre le pilier de gauche du cadre. La poussière tombe du ferraillage. SFX choc du corps contre le béton. dialog: Bruiser (basse rocailleuse, grognement plus fort), avant-bras sur la poitrine, then says: "Thirty new camera presets. A light console. Fifty palettes."

- beat 4, 10.5s to 14s: gros plan sur le corps à corps, caméra basse. Bruiser lui enfonce deux fois le genou dans les côtes, puis Volodymyr agrippe les revers de cuir et enfonce son front dans le nez moustachu. SFX deux expirations sèches, craquement d’os. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, légèrement rauque, souffle cassant le premier mot), then says: "The camera presets are the only real thing in there."

- beat 5, 14s to 17.5s: s’éloigne légèrement en plan moyen tandis que Bruiser chancelle de trois pas, crache du sang sur la flaque, puis lance un large coup. SFX éclaboussure liquide sur ciment mouillé, déplacement d’air du coup manqué. dialog: Bruiser (basse rocailleuse, grognement menaçant), blood over the moustache, then says: "Acting console. Six emotions. Video extend both ways."

- beat 6, 17.5s to 21.5s: l’orbite passe sur Volodymyr. Il laisse passer le coup au-dessus de son épaule gauche, puis plante le pied avant, puis soulève Bruiser d’un uppercut. SFX botte contre botte, claquement humide du coup. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, résonnant dans la poitrine, ton plat), then says: "All of that is one prompt in plain Seedance."

- beat 7, 21.5s to 25.5s: l’orbite accélère vers la fin. Volodymyr place un overhand droit sur la tempe, les genoux cèdent, et Bruiser s’effondre face contre terre dans la flaque, l’éclaboussure s’ouvrant en fleur. SFX grosse claque dans l’eau stagnante, puis silence pendant un beat. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, plus bas, souffle haché), debout au-dessus de lui, then says: "You are paying for buttons."

- beat 8, 25.5s to 30s: l’orbite se stabilise de face à 0° et pousse en gros plan. Volodymyr regarde d’abord le corps immobile, puis relève la tête vers l’objectif, le sang gouttant de ses jointures. reaction: souffle haché et audible, rougeur de sang sur les joues et le cou, sueur depuis la ligne des cheveux, pores et fines rides visibles, un clignement lent avant les mots. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, résonnant dans la poitrine, ton plat, légèrement rauque, plus bas à chaque phrase), then says: "Don't trust marketing bullshit. Use your head. Think critically."

TECHNICAL :

- continuous_shot: pas de coupe, un seul plan continu, un seul take, une seule orbite handheld du premier au dernier frame, 30 secondes au total

- no subtitles, no captions, no on screen text, no background

ja.content:
REFS:

@Video 1 = Volodymyr の顔。顔、髪、肌のみを制御。

@Image 1 = Volodymyr の衣装。服装と体格のみを制御。顔は @Video 1 から取得し、このシート上のマスクされた楕円は出力に含めない。

@Image 2 = Bruiser。顔、口ひげ、傷跡、体格、服装のみを制御。

ACTIVE REFERENCES: 3つすべて 100%。スタジオ背景と参照フレーミングは出力に含めない。

SCALE: Volodymyr は 192 cm で細身、Bruiser は 178 cm で 140 kg。

DURATION: 30秒、ワンテイク、以下のビートタイミングは厳密。

GLOBAL:

- lighting: ドック天井のゲル入り蛍光管が1列、半分ティール、半分マゼンタ。これが唯一の光源。濡れた床がそれをフィルとして反射する

- color_grade: 35mmフィルムのスチル、Kodak Vision3 500T、細かな粒子、チューブにハレーション。約60%の冷たいティール（コンクリート、水、霞）＋約25%のマゼンタ（肌、レザー）＋約15%のバイオレット（影側）

- setting: 夜の地下荷捌きドック、コンクリートの柱、鉄筋むき出しの天井、濡れた床のオイルスリック

- ambience: 変圧器のうなり、滴る水、濡れたセメントを踏むブーツの擦れ音。アンビエンスは各セリフの下に潜る

- atmosphere: どの奥行きにも湿った霞、2人とも息が白く見える、衝撃のたびに水しぶきが横に流れて落ち着く

- characters:

<Volodymyr> @Video 1 と @Image 1 に準拠: 黒いシャツを開けて白いリブタンクトップの上に着用、レンガ色のカーゴパンツ、黒い編み込みベルト、白いソールの黒スニーカー、首元に細いシルバーチェーン、右手首に赤いストラップの時計、短い茶髪を後ろに流している、beat 1 以降は下唇に裂傷。最後まで完全に同一に保つ。voice: 中低音、響きがあり、急がず、胸に響く、平坦なトーン、わずかにしゃがれ声。平坦なラインはすべての打撃を通して維持し、最後の3文ではさらに静かになる

<Bruiser> @Image 2 に準拠: 使い込まれた茶色のレザーバイカージャケットを開けて黒いシャツの上に着用、破れた黒ジーンズ、坊主頭、頭頂から左頬へ長く伸びる淡い傷跡、濃いジンジャー色の口ひげ。最後まで完全に同一に保つ。voice: 低い砂利のようなバス、ゆっくりした威嚇的な唸り声、形勢が悪くなるほど大きく押し出すように話す

- camera_character: 終始ハンドヘルド、オペレーターの呼吸、手ブレ、小さなライブリフレームあり

- blocking: 2人は2本の柱の間で3フィート離れて向かい合って開始。Volodymyr の背中は奥のランプ側、手前の柱は Bruiser の右肩越し、2人の間にオイルスリック。互いにそのスリック越しに対峙し、締めのセリフでは Volodymyr がまず足元の体に視線を落とし、その後レンズへ視線を上げる

- dialogue rule: 2人とも戦いの最中も話し続け、打撃で息が言葉を途切れさせる。各セリフは必ずカメラに乗る

SHOT:

- shot_type: medium two shot, Bruiser x 20% to 55%, Volodymyr x 50% to 85%, both y 10% to 95%

- camera_angle: eye level、オービットが締まるにつれて少し低くなる

- azimuth: Volodymyr に対して 45° の三分の一正面、カメラの弧の中だけで回転

- camera_motion: 2人の周囲を反時計回りに1回だけ連続ハンドヘルドオービット、2.5メートルから1.2メートルへ接近、2人から絶対に離れない

- lens: 47° の標準ノーマル、rectilinear、柱の垂直線はまっすぐ、焦点のドリフトなし

ACTIONS. Dialogue language: American English throughout.

- beat 1, 0s to 3.5s: medium two shot. Bruiser が体重を落とし、右のフックを Volodymyr の顎に入れる。頭が自分の右肩方向へ弾かれ、汗が飛ぶ。SFX: 拳が顎に当たる乾いた音。dialog: Bruiser (low gravel bass, menacing growl), chin down, then says: "Higgsfield dropped Cinema Studio 4. Full production control."

- beat 2, 3.5s to 7s: Bruiser の肩越しに medium close up へ寄る。Volodymyr は右手の甲で唇の血を拭い、その後両足を踏み固める。reaction: まばたきの途中で目が一瞬空白になり、その後フォーカスを戻して維持。dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, flat toned, faintly hoarse), blood on his teeth, level gaze, then says: "It's Seedance 2.5 with a panel bolted on top."

pt.content:
REFS:

@Video 1 = rosto de Volodymyr. Controla apenas rosto, cabelo e pele.

@Image 1 = guarda-roupa de Volodymyr. Controla apenas roupa e porte físico; o rosto vem de @Video 1, o oval mascarado nessa folha fica fora da saída.

@Image 2 = Bruiser. Controla apenas rosto, bigode, cicatrizes, porte físico e roupa.

REFERÊNCIAS ATIVAS: as três em 100%. Fundos de estúdio e enquadramentos de referência ficam fora da saída.

ESCALA: Volodymyr 192 cm e magro, Bruiser 178 cm e 140 kg.

DURAÇÃO: 30 segundos, uma tomada, os tempos dos beats abaixo são exatos.

GLOBAL:

- lighting: uma fileira de tubos fluorescentes com gel no teto do cais, metade teal metade magenta, a única fonte; o piso molhado devolve isso como fill

- color_grade: still de filme 35mm, Kodak Vision3 500T, grão fino, halation nos tubos. ~60% teal frio (concreto, água, névoa) + ~25% magenta (pele, couro) + ~15% violeta (lados em sombra)

- setting: cais subterrâneo de carga à noite, pilares de concreto, teto com vergalhões expostos, manchas de óleo em piso molhado

- ambience: zumbido de transformador, água pingando, arrastar de botas no cimento molhado; a ambiência abaixa sob cada fala

- atmosphere: névoa úmida em todos os planos de profundidade, vapor da respiração nos dois homens, cada impacto lança respingos que derivam de lado e assentam

- characters:

<Volodymyr> conforme @Video 1 e @Image 1: camisa preta aberta sobre regata branca canelada, calça cargo vermelho tijolo, cinto preto trançado, tênis pretos com solas brancas, corrente fina de prata no pescoço, relógio com pulseira vermelha no PULSO DIREITO, cabelo castanho curto penteado para trás, lábio inferior cortado a partir do beat 1. Manter idêntico o tempo todo. voice: médio-grave, projetada, sem pressa, ressonante no peito, tom plano, levemente rouca; a linha plana se mantém em todos os golpes e fica mais baixa nas últimas três frases

<Bruiser> conforme @Image 2: jaqueta biker de couro marrom desgastado aberta sobre camisa preta, jeans pretos rasgados, careca, cicatriz longa e pálida atravessando o topo da cabeça e descendo pela bochecha ESQUERDA, bigode grosso ruivo. Manter idêntico o tempo todo. voice: baixo grave áspero, rosnado lento e ameaçador, ficando mais alto à medida que perde terreno

- camera_character: handheld o tempo todo, respiração do operador, tremor de mão, pequenos re-enquadramentos ao vivo

- blocking: eles começam a três pés de distância entre dois pilares, de frente um para o outro, as costas de Volodymyr voltadas para a rampa ao fundo, o pilar mais próximo sobre o ombro direito de Bruiser, uma mancha de óleo entre eles; cada um mantém o outro atravessando essa mancha, e na fala final Volodymyr primeiro baixa o olhar para o corpo aos seus pés, depois ergue para a lente

- dialogue rule: os dois continuam falando durante a luta, a respiração quebrando as palavras nos impactos, cada fala entrando em câmera

SHOT:

- shot_type: two shot médio, Bruiser x 20% a 55%, Volodymyr x 50% a 85%, ambos y 10% a 95%

- camera_angle: na altura dos olhos, descendo aos poucos conforme a órbita aperta

- azimuth: três quartos 45° em Volodymyr, girando apenas pelo arco da câmera

- camera_motion: uma órbita handheld contínua no sentido anti-horário ao redor do par, fechando de 2,5 metros para 1,2, sem nunca sair dos dois homens

- lens: 47° standard normal, retilinear, verticais retas nos pilares, sem drift de foco

ACTIONS. Dialogue language: American English throughout.

- beat 1, 0s to 3.5s: medium two shot. Bruiser drops his weight, then hooks his right into Volodymyr's jaw. The head snaps toward his own right shoulder, sweat spraying. SFX crack of knuckle on jaw. dialog: Bruiser (low gravel bass, menacing growl), chin down, then says: "Higgsfield dropped Cinema Studio 4. Full production control."

- beat 2, 3.5s to 7s: tightens to medium close up past Bruiser's shoulder. Volodymyr wipes blood off his lip with the back of his RIGHT hand, then plants both feet. reaction: eyes go blank mid blink, then refocus and hold. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, flat toned, faintly hoarse), blood on his teeth, level gaze, then says: "It's Seedance 2.5 with a panel bolted on top."

- beat 3, 7s to 10.5s: widens to medium shot, camera shoulders in with the charge. Bruiser roars and charges, then slams Volodymyr back into the frame left pillar. Dust sifts off the rebar. SFX thud of body into concrete. dialog: Bruiser (low gravel bass, growl pushing louder), forearm across the chest, then says: "Thirty new camera presets. A light console. Fifty palettes."

- beat 4, 10.5s to 14s: close up on the clinch, camera low. Bruiser knees the ribs twice, then Volodymyr grips the leather lapels and drives his forehead into the moustached nose. SFX two sharp exhales, crunch of bone. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, faintly hoarse, breath breaking the first word), then says: "The camera presets are the only real thing in there."

- beat 5, 14s to 17.5s: eases out to medium shot as Bruiser staggers three steps, spits blood onto the slick, then swings wide. SFX liquid splat on wet cement, air displacement of the miss. dialog: Bruiser (low gravel bass, menacing growl), blood over the moustache, then says: "Acting console. Six emotions. Video extend both ways."

- beat 6, 17.5s to 21.5s: the arc carries onto Volodymyr. He slips the swing past his own left shoulder, then stamps the lead boot, then lifts Bruiser on an uppercut. SFX boot on boot, wet smack of the punch. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, chest resonant, flat toned), then says: "All of that is one prompt in plain Seedance."

- beat 7, 21.5s to 25.5s: orbit speeds through the finish. Volodymyr lands an overhand right to the temple, the knees fold, and Bruiser goes down face first into the puddle, spray blooming. SFX heavy slap into standing water, then silence for one beat. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, quieter, breath ragged), standing over him, then says: "You are paying for buttons."

- beat 8, 25.5s to 30s: the orbit settles frontal 0° and pushes into a close up. Volodymyr first looks down at the motionless body, then lifts his head into the lens, blood dripping off his knuckles. reaction: breath ragged and audible, blood flush on cheeks and neck, sweat from the hairline, pores and fine lines held, one slow blink before the words. dialog: Volodymyr (mid low, chest resonant, flat toned, faintly hoarse, quieter on each sentence), then says: "Don't trust marketing bullshit. Use your head. Think critically."

TECHNICAL:

- continuous_shot: no scene cuts, one continuous shot, single take, one handheld orbit from first frame to last, 30 seconds total

- no subtitles, no captions, no on screen text, no background music over the dialogue, no extra dialogue beyond the lines written

zh.content:
REFS：

@Video 1 = Volodymyr 的脸。仅控制脸、头发和皮肤。

@Image 1 = Volodymyr 的服装。仅控制衣着和体型；脸部来自 @Video 1，该图上的遮罩椭圆不出现在输出中。

@Image 2 = Bruiser。仅控制脸、胡子、疤痕、体型和衣着。

ACTIVE REFERENCES：三者全部 100%。工作室背景和参考构图不出现在输出中。

SCALE：Volodymyr 身高 192 cm，瘦长；Bruiser 身高 178 cm，体重 140 kg。

DURATION：30 秒，一镜到底，以下节拍时间精确无误。

GLOBAL：

- lighting: 码头天花板上一排加了色胶的荧光灯管，半青绿半洋红，是唯一光源；湿地面将其反射回来作为补光

- color_grade: 35mm 胶片静帧，Kodak Vision3 500T，细颗粒，灯管有光晕。约 60% 冷青绿（混凝土、水汽、薄雾）+ 约 25% 洋红（皮肤、皮革）+ 约 15% 紫罗兰（阴影侧）

- setting: 夜晚的地下装卸码头，混凝土立柱、裸露钢筋天花板、湿地面上的油膜

- ambience: 变压器嗡鸣、滴水声、靴底在湿水泥上的摩擦声；环境声在每句台词下方压低

- atmosphere: 每个景深平面都有潮湿薄雾，两人都能看到呼气白雾，每次撞击都会溅起水花并向侧面飘散后落下

- characters:

<Volodymyr> 按 @Video 1 和 @Image 1：黑衬衫敞开，内穿白色罗纹背心，砖红色工装裤，黑色编织腰带，黑色运动鞋配白色鞋底，颈间细银链，右手腕红色表带手表，短棕发向后梳，从 beat 1 开始下唇有裂口。全程保持一致。voice: 中低音，穿透力强，不急不缓，胸腔共鸣，平直音色，略带沙哑；这种平直感贯穿每次挨打，并在最后三句更轻

<Bruiser> 按 @Image 2：做旧棕色皮革机车夹克敞开，内穿黑衬衫，破洞黑牛仔裤，光头，头顶一路延伸到左脸颊的一道长而浅的疤，浓重姜色胡子。全程保持一致。voice: 低沉砂砾般的男低音，缓慢而带威胁的咆哮，随着逐渐失势而越来越大声

- camera_character: 全程手持，能感到操作者呼吸、手部轻微抖动、实时小幅重构图

- blocking: 两人起始时相距三英尺，站在两根立柱之间，彼此正面对峙，Volodymyr 背对远处坡道，近侧立柱位于 Bruiser 自己右肩后方，两人之间有一片油膜；他们始终隔着那片油膜对峙，在最后一句时 Volodymyr 先低头看向脚边的尸体，然后抬眼看向镜头

- dialogue rule: 两人打斗过程中始终在说话，受击时呼吸打断台词，每一句都要落在镜头上

SHOT：

- shot_type: 中景双人镜头，Bruiser 占画面 x 20% 到 55%，Volodymyr 占画面 x 50% 到 85%，两人 y 10% 到 95%

- camera_angle: 眼平，随着环绕收紧逐渐降低
